text:
katie: FYI I saw a 3x latency spike on /v1/generate for a cohort right after the console quick-edit flipped flag `enable_fast_path`. Looks like many requests went to fallback model.

morgan: That was me, I thought quick-edit staged it. The UI shows apply but doesn't clearly show scope. My bad.

rahul: Two issues: our config store currently treats PATCH and PUT the same (replace). We should make PATCH merge/patch semantics and leave PUT as explicit replace. Also add `dry_run=true` to writes so console can call a preflight service.

katie: Telemetry needs: per-flag `surge_score`, per-route `fallback_rate`, and an `override_source` field in the flag timeline so we can filter console blasts.

morgan: UX fix: modal confirm for scope >10% with suggested staged rollout (1%,10%,50%,100%) and estimated token delta + fallback risk. I'll draft a short RFC.

rahul: I'll prototype a preflight microservice that returns risk report (historical latency, quota headroom, recent fallbacks) used by `dry_run`.

devops-bot: Alert: routing-fallback-rate exceeded threshold @2026-03-20T15:02Z :rotating_light:

katie: Action items: (1) morgan RFC + modal, (2) rahul preflight + API param, (3) katie dashboard + alert tweaks, (4) ops retro. I'll own the retro.

rahul: Scheduling a 30m sync tomorrow to align API schema and preflight response.

morgan: Sorry again 60a will be more cautious.
